name: FlixBus / FlixTrain European GTFS (transport.data.gouv.fr + gtfs.gis.flix.tech)

timetableApi.notes: File-based GTFS Schedule plus a GTFS-RT TripUpdates feed. This source has no query or search API. The partner API is a separate source: see flixbus-partner-api.

coverage: Whole European FlixBus and FlixTrain network, as a single feed: two agencies (FLIXBUS-eu, FLIXTRAIN-eu) and 2,117 stops. Stops seen in stops.txt include Zurich Bus Station, Zurich Airport, Chur, Lugano, Bellinzona, Bolzano South (Stazione FS), Innsbruck Südbahnstraße, Milan Lampugnano, Milan Assago, Munich central bus station and Munich Airport. feed_info validity: 2026-10-25 to 2027-04-25. On transport.data.gouv.fr the spatial metadata says 'France', but the content is pan-European.

license.name: ODbL 1.0 with transport.data.gouv.fr 'Conditions Particulières d'utilisation'
license.notes: Reproduction, modification and commercial use are allowed. Obligations: (1) attribute the contributors and the ODbL licence (a 'data sources' page is enough in apps); (2) share-alike, which the PAN conditions narrow to derived databases of the same nature, granularity, period and geographic extent; (3) any re-shared derived database must be published on transport.data.gouv.fr in its original format. A different-nature produced work, such as a journey-planner result, is not subject to re-sharing.

reliability: transport.data.gouv.fr quality indicators: 100% availability, conformity and freshness; validation 'À jour' with 50 info-level notices. Mobility Database (tdg-11681): official feed, no validation errors, Seal of Reliability. The GTFS-RT resource shows 40 validation errors.
refreshFrequency: No stated cadence. Last-Modified 2026-10-25, and the history shows several new versions per month (2026-10-20, 2026-10-26). Each version covers about 6 months.

evidence.finding: Dataset 'Réseau européen FlixBus et FlixTrain' by Flixbus France: GTFS at https://gtfs.gis.flix.tech/gtfs_generic_eu.zip and GTFS-RT trip-update at global.api.flixbus.com; licence 'ODbL et Conditions Particulières d'utilisation'; quality 100%.

PAN conditions particulières: share-alike limited to same nature/granularity/period/extent; only derived databases must be re-shared, on transport.data.gouv.fr; attribution may be on a 'sources' page.
Official feed, licence ODbL-1.0, 1,180 routes (rail and bus), service range 2026-10-25 to 2027-04-25, no errors, Seal of Reliability.

HEAD 200, application/zip, 31,611,740 bytes, Last-Modified Sun, 25 Oct 2026 21:07:14 GMT. A range-read of the ZIP directory showed no fares.txt. agency_fare_url is https://shop.flixbus.com (generic). stops.txt has 2,117 stops, including Zurich, Bolzano, Innsbruck, Milan and Munich.
GET 200, application/octet-stream, about 822 KB, no authentication. HEAD returns 403.
The stable data.gouv.fr resource URL redirects (302) to https://gtfs.gis.flix.tech/gtfs_generic_eu.zip.
Separate official Flixbus GB feed at gtfs.gis.flix.tech/gtfs_generic_gb.zip, with no licence stated on the Mobility Database page.
Trafiklab GTFS Regional lists a 'flixbus' operator feed under CC0 1.0; an API key is required (opendata.samtrafiken.se/gtfs/flixbus/flixbus.zip returns 403 without a key).

notes: This is the best candidate for a first real import. Other FlixBus GTFS files on the same host: gtfs_generic_gb.zip (HEAD 200, 2,132,402 bytes) and gtfs_generic_turkey.zip (HEAD 200, 9,150,942 bytes); Mobility Database lists them as official but shows no licence for them, so their reuse licence is unknown. The ODbL licence applies to the copy distributed via transport.data.gouv.fr. Agency timezone is UTC, which must be handled. shapes.txt is about 154 MB uncompressed. The feed has no prices or seat availability.

reliability: Daily quality indicators (availability, conformity, freshness), validators and history archives per resource.
